note: Known JavaScript/ClojureScript semantics (js/, #js, clj->js, js->clj, .-length, cljs, catch :default) in the Clojure course, removed by Phase 3. Entries are course|lesson|field|token; list indexes are collapsed (content[].code), so moving a block does not require a refresh. Refresh with `yarn check:semantics --update-baseline` after reviewing the output; `yarn check:semantics --strict` proves the course is clean.
